reportTemplate.summary: On {{v1}}'s detail page I used each part's Delete action. Both triggered a custom "Confirm" dialog (not a native one): for Part A "Delete the part \"{{v5}}\" from this ticket? This cannot be undone." (with Cancel / Delete part buttons) and the same wording for Part B; I clicked "Delete part" each time and the table refreshed after each. Afterwards the parts table showed only the empty-state "No parts on this ticket yet." — no total row is rendered at all, so no $0.00 figure is displayed. I then clicked "Archive ticket": this produced NO confirmation dialog, it archived immediately and the button became "Unarchive ticket". The detail page now shows Status "{{v4}}" with an "Archived" badge and buttons Mark Draft / Mark Closed / Unarchive ticket. On the Tickets list (http://127.0.0.1:4180/#/tickets) {{v1}} does not appear among the 13 active tickets, but appears when "Show archived" is ticked as "{{v1}} | {{v2}} [Archived] | Not recorded | {{v4}} | 0 | 2026-09-14" — i.e. the ticket has no parts and is no longer active.
